newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gist-Brocades net profit rises 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gist-Brocades net profit rises 10 pct.

text.p: Dutch biochemicals and food group Gist-Brocades NV said on Wednesday its net profit rose 10 percent to 158.5 million guilders ($84.4 million) in 1996 from 114.1 million in 1995.
The company said it would pay a 1996 dividend of 1.60 guilder per share, up from 1.50 guilders in 1995. ($ = 1.878 Dutch Guilders)
Turnover grew to 2.02 billion guilders from 1.84 billion in 1995, exceeding the two billion guilders threshold for the first time in the company's history.
Gist-Brocades said turnover rose because of takeovers, cooperation pacts and organic growth. Sales rose strongest in Asia and Australia, it added.
The company said its businesses were showing steady growth, adding that this year should bring a further rise in earnings.
"Provided exchange rate fluctuations are not excessive, we expect the profit before extraordinary income and expense for 1997 to show a clear increase on 1996," it said.
